HFGCS Livestream Gallery

← Back to index

Every HFGCS livestream on the NEET INTEL channel, one panel per UTC day. A is the first half of the day and B the second — cut on US Eastern midnight and noon until August 2025, on UTC since September 2025. Auxiliary streams — other frequencies, other regions, event and commentary coverage — sit beside them. Each window is the stream's own go-live time and run length; a faded rail is a window inferred from that month's habit because the recording's metadata is missing.

Bars are that day's logged EAM traffic in 20-minute periods, coloured by group; the rail underneath is what was on tape. Click a bar to open the stream that was on air 20 seconds before the first message in that period. Left and right arrows step the whole calendar through the A and B halves of every day, wrapping round; with a day open they run through that day's own streams in turn — A, B, then any auxiliary — before moving to the next day.

The timeline field says whether its bars are the whole story. Flat: the recording has been reviewed — a DTCP timecard exists, or a certified-zero marker — so the bars are complete and an empty stretch is real silence. Hatched, dashed frame: no timecard, so the bars are a floor and a gap in them is an absence of notes rather than of traffic. 809 days on tape: 474 reviewed, 335 to go (123 of them with nothing logged). lists the days still to review, and rn narrows that to the ones with nothing logged at all.

Days
YYMMDD
a date. Partials work: 2601 = January 2026; - matches any digit: --06 = every June, ----01 = every 1st
C###
days with an EAM of that length: C120; C32,27 = days with all of them
G#
days with that group: G2; G23 = both 2 and 3
R
days still to review (no DTCP timecard); RN = nothing logged either, RP = some messages logged, RD = already carded
S#
days with that stream: SA, SB, ST, SH…; SX = any auxiliary stream, S-B = no B stream
Combine
&
and: 26&C292
x
at the end: collapse unrelated weeks: 2601x, C32,27x
.2601
jump without filtering
